title: An interrupt between the creation of the landing lock file and the write of its record leaves an empty lock file that every landing of the clone waits out the grace period for
goal: landing_lock removes the lock file it created on any interrupt, also one that lands between os.open of the lock file and the write of its record, and closes the file descriptor

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_close
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", t], check=True)
path = bl_close.landing_lock_path(t)
real, n = os.fdopen, [0]
def boom(*a, **k):
    n[0] += 1
    if n[0] == 2:
        os.fdopen = real
        raise KeyboardInterrupt
    return real(*a, **k)
os.fdopen = boom
try:
    with bl_close.landing_lock(t, "ST-aaaaaaaa"):
        pass
except BaseException as e:
    print("interrupted by", type(e).__name__)
finally:
    os.fdopen = real
print("lock file left behind:", os.path.exists(path))
sys.exit(0 if not os.path.exists(path) else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_close
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", t], check=True)
real_open, real_fdopen = os.open, os.fdopen
fds, n = [], [0]
def spy_open(*a, **k):
    fd = real_open(*a, **k)
    fds.append(fd)
    return fd
def boom(*a, **k):
    n[0] += 1
    if n[0] == 2:
        raise KeyboardInterrupt
    return real_fdopen(*a, **k)
os.open, os.fdopen = spy_open, boom
try:
    with bl_close.landing_lock(t, "ST-aaaaaaaa"):
        pass
except BaseException as e:
    print("interrupted by", type(e).__name__)
finally:
    os.open, os.fdopen = real_open, real_fdopen
lock_fd = fds[-1] if fds else -1
try:
    os.fstat(lock_fd)
    print("lock descriptor still open:", lock_fd)
    sys.exit(1)
except OSError:
    print("lock descriptor closed")

clauses.clause: landing_lock removes the lock file it created on any interrupt, also one that lands between os.open of the lock file and the write of its record
